stress.noise_law: paired raw narrowband realization; tangent projection onto chirp derivative residualized against constant, sine, cosine, frequency direction; orthogonal complement; original component amplitudes, no renormalization; exact phase mimic pair as separate impossibility control
stress.start_policy: R4B8A legacy geometry with prefit .35 replacing one of four fixed random starts; same candidates
stress.metric: candidate availability, true parameters, correct candidate existed but selection wrong, labels, drift and confidence coverage; exact indistinguishability evaluated separately, no requirement impossible to satisfy

forecast.note: same historical R4B8A bank; measure final versus local gap accuracy; no real early stopping

calibration.generator: new explicit-truth bank, six logarithmic cycles, 769 samples, period 1.2..5.6, envelope beta .6..1.4, near-chirp signed drift .015..15e-2; stationary has no finite tstar or phase truth
calibration.score: n*log(RSS_profile_at_true_drift/RSS_unrestricted) clipped at zero, same fit-window data weights; jointly refit gap, frequency, envelope and linear amplitudes, unrestricted fit also drift; diagnostic of actual truth inclusion; calibration global maximum of per-stratum split conformal order statistics k=ceil((n+1)*.95); no noise-family truth supplied to inference; failed profiles treated as infinite, no deletion
calibration.classification: frozen rival/period screen; accept DSS only if unrestricted best drift strictly inside margin, nonempty profiled grid set and all admitted grid points strictly within margin; numerical grid approximation only; continuous confidence region not certified; no expansion of physical admission; report baseline and candidate separately
calibration.coverage_gate: >=90% empirical per eligible nonstationary stratum, report exact binomial uncertainty and failures, nominal 95%; scientific hold remains even if gates pass
calibration.ambiguity_diagnostic: old CI unconditional on all nonstationary; oracle versus blind nuisance; old gate decomposition fit failure, width>2margin, center outside, boundary overlap, equivalent; cross-tab correct parameters and labels; PIT for positive true drift zero; no causal conclusion from CI alone

execution: tangent stress completes before forecast and calibration; evaluation consumes frozen calibration artifact after its hash is verified; protocol file immutable; synthetic only; if tangent mimic nonidentifiable, preserve ambiguous evidence, no threshold relaxation
